items.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember Phil Woods said this thing... He said you know if you’re thinking about being a jazz tenor player...

ctx.x: Yeah, yes, yes. It’s a passion and someone who doesn’t love it shouldn’t mess with this.

Do you see that in your students? Does it occur to you – I remember Phil Woods said this thing, I’ll be very brief about it. He said you know if you’re thinking about being a jazz tenor player or a brain surgeon, be the brain surgeon and play tenor on the weekends.
